HBRGOSAKIMOD-NUMERIC_VALUE.hover.desc: Click the percentage to edit it. Enter or leaving the field saves; Esc cancels. Range: 0–1000%.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-MOD_U_I.title: ModUI
HBRGOSAKIMOD-MOD_U_I.hover.desc: Enable the global HUD layout: vertical potions; gold, room, floor and boss information near tama; HP/DP in the top bar; character powers wrap beside DP without covering gold. Disable to restore the original layout.
Use Big Dog Chew! card art
Displays Additional Shot as Big Dog Chew! with alternate card art.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-FINISHER_PRESENTATION.title: Finisher show
HBRGOSAKIMOD-FINISHER_PRESENTATION.hover: How Magic Sword Lucky Seven is shown. Full screen: dims the battle, summons the sword, slashes, then shows the combined damage, about 2 seconds; click or press any key to skip. Simplified: only the slashes and the total on the enemies, without interrupting play. Off: no show. A teammate's Lucky Seven shows at most the simplified version. Visual only; the damage is unchanged.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-FORCE_MOD_ELITE_BOSS_ENCOUN: Always selects this mod's elite encounter when one exists in the current elite pool. Does not affect bosses.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-FORCE_MOD_BOSS_ENCOUNTERS.h: Always selects this mod's boss when one exists in the current boss pool.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_HIGH_DIMENSIONAL_SHEL: Enemy High-Dimensional Shell as a percentage of maximum HP. At Ascension 10, the calculated amount is multiplied by 1.5.
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_DP_GROWTH_PER_ACT_PER: DP is calculated from adjusted maximum HP and the shell percentage, then multiplied per act. Act 1 has no extra growth. At 20%: Act 2 is ×1.2, Act 3 is ×1.44, then ×1.2 again each act.
Enemy DP growth per act (exact value)
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_MAX_HP_PERCENT.title: Enemy maximum HP multiplier
Percentage of the enemy's original maximum HP. 100% keeps the original value. Adjusted HP has a minimum of 1, including at 0%.
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above. HP has a minimum of 1.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_MAX_HP_GROWTH_PER_ACT: Enemy maximum HP growth per act
Compounds on the maximum HP multiplier each act. Act 1 has no extra growth. At 20%: Act 2 is ×1.2, Act 3 is ×1.44, then ×1.2 again each act. HP has a minimum of 1.
Enemy maximum HP growth per act (exact value)
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_DAMAGE_PERCENT.title: Enemy damage multiplier
Percentage of the enemy's original damage. 100% keeps the original value.
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-ENEMY_DAMAGE_GROWTH_PER_ACT: Compounds on the damage multiplier each act. Act 1 has no extra growth. At 20%: Act 2 is ×1.2, Act 3 is ×1.44, then ×1.2 again each act.
Enemy damage growth per act (exact value)
Enter an integer from 0 to 1000. This value stays synchronized with the slider above.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-UPLOAD_RUN_DATA.title: Upload run data to hbrgo.com
HBRGOSAKIMOD-UPLOAD_RUN_DATA.hover.desc: You are asked the first time you open the mod; only "Allow" turns it on. Turning it on here shows the same explanation again. If a run is in progress when you turn it on (including a saved run not yet finished), that run is not uploaded; recording starts with the next run. Fully anonymous: no Steam ID, name, computer paths or mod list, and the IP is never stored or shown. Each finished run is uploaded (map and path, event options, card rewards, battles turn by turn, HBR values) and only HQ accounts on hbrgo.com can view it. Runs with a modifier mod, runs changed through the console (such as adding cards or relics, or changing gold or HP), and runs that end within the first 5 floors are not uploaded. Turning it off stops recording and uploading at once.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-RUN_UPLOAD_INSTALL_ID.title: Anonymous ID
HBRGOSAKIMOD-RUN_UPLOAD_INSTALL_ID.hover: A random ID created when you allow uploading, not linked to your Steam account. Use it to ask for your uploaded data to be deleted.
Copies the anonymous ID to the clipboard. Send it to the HQ team to have your data deleted.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-REGENERATE_RUN_UPLOAD_INSTA: Switches to a new anonymous ID. Runs uploaded after this cannot be linked to earlier ones; the old ID is copied to the clipboard so you can still have the earlier data deleted.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-CLEAR_RUN_UPLOAD_LOCAL_DATA: Deletes the run records on this computer that have not been sent, and what has been recorded of the current run. Data already uploaded is not affected, and the anonymous ID is kept.
HBRGOSAKIMOD-THIRTY_G_PROPOSAL_PRESENTAT: 控制30G求婚演出。关闭后仍照常求婚、结算卒与心动、san和人气。
HBRGOSAKIMOD-MEMORY_GARDEN_UPGRADE_STORY: Show memories after Memory Garden card upgrades. All: each chapter once per run. Unseen only: skip chapters completed or manually skipped on this device. Off: do not play them. Upgrades, rewards and other stories are unchanged.
